picks.title: Episode Fifty-Four: Funayūrei, Japanese Ghost Ships 🌊 it's Testicle Tuesday!

These ships full of drowned sailors want one thing: to add to their crew by any means necessary (including using ladles to sink your ship). picks.reason: Explores Japanese maritime folklore and ghost ship myths with cultural context.

picks.title: EP: 462 Werewolves, a White Pony, and a 100 Year Promise with Marcus Young
picks.summary:
Marcus Young grows up in a family that hunts werewolves. This is not folklore, and it is not a campfire story. His great-uncle Harold empties both barrels of buckshot into a creature swaying on a log, and it screams, bleeds a river, and vanishes without a trace a mile and a half into the jungle. His grandfather keeps a matchbox of the hair as proof. Then one night the creatures come for Marcus. Two of them materialize in his bedroom, red eyes and long claws, and one turns to the other and asks whether they should take him now or wait.
